specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify login page loads with correct title and branding
title: OrangeHRM Login - AC1: Verify login page loads with correct title and branding
steps:
1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/
2. Verify the page title is 'OrangeHRM'
3. Verify the OrangeHRM logo is visible
4. Verify the 'Login' heading is displayed
5. Verify the Username and Password fields are visible
expected: Login page loads with correct title 'OrangeHRM', logo is visible, 'Login' heading is displayed, and Username/Password fields are present

specTitle: Test Case 2: Verify successful login with valid credentials
title: OrangeHRM Login - AC2: Verify successful login with valid Admin credentials
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page (https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/
2. Enter 'Admin' in the Username field
3. Enter 'admin123' in the Password field
4. Click the 'Login' button
5. Verify the URL changes to /web/index.php/dashboard/index
6. Verify the 'Dashboard' heading is displayed
expected: User is redirected to the Dashboard page at /web/index.php/dashboard/index and the 'Dashboard' heading is visible

specTitle: Test Case 3: Verify login fails with invalid credentials
title: OrangeHRM Login - AC3: Verify login fails with invalid credentials and shows error
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps:
1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/
2. Enter 'InvalidUser' in the Username field
3. Enter 'wrongpassword' in the Password field
4. Click the 'Login' button
5. Verify the error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed
6. Verify the user remains on the login page
expected: 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page

specTitle: Test Case 4: Verify login fails with empty username and password
title: OrangeHRM Login - AC4: Verify login validation for empty credentials
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps:
1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/
2. Leave the Username field empty
3. Leave the Password field empty
4. Click the 'Login' button
5. Verify 'Required' validation message is displayed for both fields
expected: 'Required' validation message is displayed under both Username and Password fields

specTitle: Test Case 5: Verify Forgot Password link is visible and navigates correctly
title: OrangeHRM Login - AC5: Verify Forgot Password link navigates to Reset Password page
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps:
1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/
2. Verify 'Forgot your password?' link is visible on the login page
3. Click the 'Forgot your password?' link
4. Verify the URL changes to /web/index.php/auth/requestPasswordResetCode
5. Verify 'Reset Password' heading is displayed
expected: User is navigated to the Reset Password page with the heading 'Reset Password'

specTitle: Test Case 6: Verify Dashboard page displays all widgets after login
title: OrangeHRM Dashboard - AC1: Verify Dashboard displays all expected widgets
preconditions: User is logged in as Admin and on the Dashboard page
steps:
1. Login with valid credentials (Admin/admin123)
2. Verify 'Time at Work' widget is visible
3. Verify 'My Actions' widget is visible
4. Verify 'Quick Launch' widget is visible
5. Verify 'Buzz Latest Posts' widget is visible
6. Verify 'Employees on Leave Today' widget is visible
7. Verify 'Employee Distribution by Sub Unit' widget is visible
8. Verify 'Employee Distribution by Location' widget is visible
expected: All seven dashboard widgets are visible: Time at Work, My Actions, Quick Launch, Buzz Latest Posts, Employees on Leave Today, Employee Distribution by Sub Unit, Employee Distribution by Location

specTitle: Test Case 15: Verify user can logout successfully
title: OrangeHRM Logout - AC1: Verify user can logout and is redirected to login page
preconditions: User is logged in as Admin and on the Dashboard page
steps:
1. Login with valid credentials
2. Click on the user profile dropdown in the top-right corner
3. Click 'Logout' option from the dropdown menu
4. Verify the URL changes to /web/index.php/auth/login
5. Verify the login page is displayed with Username and Password fields
expected: User is logged out and redirected to the login page at /web/index.php/auth/login

specTitle: Test Case 16: Verify sidebar search functionality filters menu items
title: OrangeHRM Sidebar - AC9: Verify sidebar search filters navigation items
preconditions: User is logged in as Admin and on the Dashboard page
steps:
1. Login with valid credentials
2. Click on the Search textbox in the sidebar
3. Type 'Admin' in the search field
4. Verify only the 'Admin' menu item is visible in the filtered results
5. Clear the search field
6. Verify all menu items are visible again
expected: Sidebar search filters menu items correctly — typing 'Admin' shows only the Admin menu item, clearing restores all items
